intro.source: Did the exact article versions bought for this answer appear in its citations? This view scores retained BUY decisions against payment observations recorded in the same dispatch trace.
intro.text: 为此答案购买的确切文章版本是否出现在引用中？此视图将留存的 BUY 决策与同一任务过程记录的付款观察进行评分比较。

recordedOnly.source: Recorded settlement bookkeeping only; Circle and chain settlement have not been independently rechecked here.
recordedOnly.text: 仅为记录的结算记账；此处没有独立复核 Circle 或链上结算。

partialTrace.source: This is a partial retained trace sample, not a full payment ledger. An absent matching payment does not prove that no payment occurred; excluded and unconfirmed costs remain unknown.
partialTrace.text: 这是部分留存过程样本，不是完整付款账本。缺少匹配付款不证明没有发生付款；被排除及未确认成本仍为未知。

unknownCohort.source: Participant cohort: unknown. No outside-customer usage is inferred.
unknownCohort.text: 参与者群体：未知。不推断外部客户使用。

counts.source: {scored} scored exact-version purchases from {buys} recorded BUY decisions; {unscored} BUY decisions unscored. {excluded} of {payments} trace payment observations excluded.
counts.text: 从 {buys} 个已记录 BUY 决策中对 {scored} 次确切版本购买评分；{unscored} 个 BUY 决策未评分。排除 {payments} 个过程付款观察中的 {excluded} 个。

countingBasis.source: Each unique source + item + content version with positive matching recorded settled access counts once. Duplicate BUYs, missing identities, zero/unconfirmed access and incompatible payment observations cannot create a scored purchase. CACHE and SKIP decisions are outside this sample.
countingBasis.text: 每个具有匹配的正金额已记录已结算访问付款的独立来源 + 条目 + 内容版本计数一次。重复 BUYs、缺失身份、零金额或未确认访问及不兼容付款观察不能构成已评分购买。CACHE 和 SKIP 决策不属于此样本。

hitRateBasis.source: {cited} cited purchases / {scored} scored purchases. A citation is an observed use, not an expert support or quality verdict.
hitRateBasis.text: {cited} 次被引用购买 / {scored} 次已评分购买。引用是观察到的使用，不是专家对支持程度或质量的判断。

noSample.source: No scored purchases; the hit rate is unmeasured.
noSample.text: 没有已评分购买；命中率未衡量。

uncitedCost.source: Recorded access cost of uncited purchases
uncitedCost.text: 未被引用购买的已记录访问成本

uncitedBasis.source: Counts only scored purchases. Descriptive access cost, not causal regret or proof that the purchase was useless.
uncitedBasis.text: 仅计入已评分购买。这是描述性访问成本，不是因果后悔值，也不证明购买无用。

calibration.text: 预测价值与观察到的引用

calibrationBasis.source: Bins compare the recorded predicted value with citation occurrence in this one dispatch. Small samples do not validate a probability model.
calibrationBasis.text: 各区间比较此次任务记录的预测价值与引用出现情况。小样本不能验证概率模型。

unknownMeasures.source: Missed value, cost per supported claim, budget alternatives and counterfactual outcomes are unmeasured. No extra reading or learning was performed.
unknownMeasures.text: 未衡量错失价值、每个有支持主张的成本、其他预算方案或反事实结果。未执行额外阅读或学习。

observations.text: 已评分的确切版本观察

reward.text: 记录的已结算引用奖励

archive.source: Frozen testnet archive, captured {capturedAt}. This is historical testnet evidence, separate from current mainnet activity.
archive.text: 冻结测试网归档，捕获于 {capturedAt}。这是历史测试网证据，与当前主网活动分开。

unavailable.source: Recorded purchase outcomes are unavailable for this retained snapshot. No score or zero-cost success is inferred; the original report and receipt remain available.
unavailable.text: 此留存快照的购买结果记录不可用。不推断评分或零成本成功；原始报告和凭证仍可访问。
